messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: std::cout in API
parts:
It'd be nice if we could remove all references to
std::cout in the API code before we release.
Right now, I'm seeing them in verbose_evolve().

I'd much rather see an output stream passed in
to these places from the outside than have things
hard coded to write to std::cout, which we can't
control in some settings. Then whoever's calling
it can pass in std::cout if they want, or a file-based
stream, or whatever.

- Bob
